# -*- coding: utf-8 -*- """ Utility module for rendering blog posts safely. """ import html from typing import Final # Predefined HTML structure with placeholders for title and body. BLOG_FORMAT: Final[str] = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Render a blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. description : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized and HTML-formatted string ready for embedding in a webpage. Notes ----- - All user-provided text is escaped to prevent XSS and other injection attacks. - The function uses a fixed template (BLOG_FORMAT) to ensure the output remains well-formed and consistent, mitigating CWE‑707 concerns about malformed data. """ # Escape special HTML characters in both heading and description safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Format the sanitized content into the predefined HTML structure rendered = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_description) return rendered.strip()
